name: Practice by Numbers
description: Dental practice software that sits on top of the practice-management system (Dentrix, Open Dental and the other big five) rather than replacing it. It started as analytics. Co-founder Rohit Garg was "running SQL queries for [his dentist wife] in the database, in the back end". It then added online booking, intake forms, VoIP phones, payments (via Adyen / Stripe) and websites. It pulls data from the PMS, QuickBooks, phones and Google Analytics. Five integrations cover the PMS systems used by "70,000 to 80,000 dental offices" (company-stated).
